ingredients.name: butter, plus more for the dish

steps.instruction: Peel and thinly slice 1 1/3 pounds of potatoes.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a pot.
Slowly add 2 tablespoons of flour, stirring all the time.

steps.spoken: Cook for 2 minutes, or until it is bubbly.

steps.instruction: Take the pot off the heat.
Slowly add 1 1/4 cups of milk, stirring all the time.
Add 3/4 of the cheese to the sauce.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Put a thin layer of potatoes in the baking dish.
Add a layer of cheese sauce.
Repeat the layers until there are no more potatoes or sauce.
Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 of the cheese on top.

steps.spoken: Bake for 45 minutes. If it starts to brown too much, cover it with foil.
